record.bible_text: Come<WH03212><WTH8798>, and let us return<WH07725><WTH8799> unto the LORD<WH03068>: for he hath torn<WH02963><WTH8804>, and he will heal<WH07495><WTH8799> us; he hath smitten<WH05221><WTH8686>, and he will bind us up<WH02280><WTH8799>.
After two days<WH03117> will he revive<WH02421><WTH8762> us: in the third<WH07992> day<WH03117> he will raise us up<WH06965><WTH8686>, and we shall live<WH02421><WTH8799> in his sight<WH06440>.

Then shall we know<WH03045><WTH8799>, <FI>if<Fi> we follow<WH07291><WTH8799> on to know<WH03045><WTH8800> the LORD<WH03068>: his going forth<WH04161> is prepared<WH03559><WTH8737> as the morning<WH07837>; and he shall come<WH0935><WTH8799> unto us as the rain<WH01653>, as the latter<WH04456> <FI>and<Fi> former rain<WH03384><WTH8802> unto the earth<WH0776>.<CM>

O Ephraim<WH0669>, what shall I do<WH06213><WTH8799> unto thee? O Judah<WH03063>, what shall I do<WH06213><WTH8799> unto thee? for your goodness<WH02617> <FI>is<Fi> as a morning<WH01242> cloud<WH06051>, and as the early<WH07925><WTH8688> dew<WH02919> it goeth away<WH01980><WTH8802>. <RF>goodness: or, mercy, or, kindness<Rf>

Therefore have I hewed<WH02672><WTH8804> <FI>them<Fi> by the prophets<WH05030>; I have slain<WH02026><WTH8804> them by the words<WH0561> of my mouth<WH06310>: and thy judgments<WH04941> <FI>are as<Fi>  the light<WH0216> <FI>that<Fi> goeth forth<WH03318><WTH8799>. <RF>and...: or, that thy judgments might be, etc<Rf>
For I desired<WH02654><WTH8804> mercy<WH02617>, and not sacrifice<WH02077>; and the knowledge<WH01847> of God<WH0430> more than burnt offerings<WH05930>.
But they like men<WH0120> have transgressed<WH05674><WTH8804> the covenant<WH01285>: there have they dealt treacherously<WH0898><WTH8804> against me. <RF>men: or, Adam<Rf>
Gilead<WH01568> <FI>is<Fi> a city<WH07151> of them that work<WH06466><WTH8802> iniquity<WH0205>, <FI>and is<Fi> polluted<WH06121> with blood<WH01818>. <RF>polluted: or, cunning for<Rf>

And as troops<WH01416> of robbers wait<WH02442><WTH8763> for a man<WH0376>, <FI>so<Fi> the company<WH02267> of priests<WH03548> murder<WH07523><WTH8762> in the way<WH01870> by consent<WH07926><WTH8677><WH07927>: for they commit<WH06213><WTH8804> lewdness<WH02154>. <RF>by...: Heb. with one shoulder, or, to Shechem<Rf> <RF>lewdness: or, enormity<Rf>

I have seen<WH07200><WTH8804> an horrible thing<WH08186> in the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478>: there <FI>is<Fi> the whoredom<WH02184> of Ephraim<WH0669>, Israel<WH03478> is defiled<WH02930><WTH8738>.
Also, O Judah<WH03063>, he hath set<WH07896><WTH8804> an harvest<WH07105> for thee, when I returned<WH07725><WTH8800> the captivity<WH07622> of my people<WH05971>.<CM>
